snippets.text: A paper from East China Normal University says SkillGym, trained on 2,756 skill-based environments, lifted Qwen3.5-35B-A3B past reported Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 Mini scores on SkillsBench v1.1.

Developer Theo Browne says Claude Code users get roughly 4.3 times more usage on Opus 5.5 than on Fable 5.1 at the same plan tier, citing Opus's lower per-token cost and a 50 percent cap on Fable use.

The Blue Cross Blue Shield Association says AI coding tools are already pushing healthcare costs up, as hospitals use them to find ways to bill more for the same care, Bloomberg's Joe Weisenthal reports.
China's tech stocks will need a domestic AI catalyst to close their valuation gap with US peers, Bloomberg Intelligence says, pegging the discount to the 'Magnificent Seven' at over 50%.
SK hynix has begun groundwork on a memory-chip fab in Japan, Korean media report, a month after the company said nothing had been decided.

Chip analysis firm SemiAnalysis said four Google TPUv7 chips came close to matching a full Cerebras wafer-scale system's interactivity, crediting inference software from Inferact using what it called megakernels.
Mentions of open AI models in US earnings calls rose sixfold year over year, with open models reaching 56% of Vercel's tokens in August and 40% of AT&T's AI workloads, the Financial Times reports.
